# 1 bed apartment for sale

> Description Drum East is a compact residential and equestrian holding extending to about 4.23 acres with a private situation. At the core of the property is a fine detached country home set amongst mature gardens and grounds. The property includes a useful range of outbuildings and a ring-fenced block of farmland.
